    shadow.getElementById('chat-ai-trigger-btn').onclick = async () => {
        const targetChar = state.contacts.find(x => x.id === currentChatTarget);

        const txt = input.value.trim();

        if (txt) {
            input.value = '';
            const newMsg = {
                id: 'm_' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5),
                sender: 'me',
                kind: 'text',
                text: txt,
                pendingSync: true,

            };

        if (pendingMsgs.length === 0) {
            alert('当前没有待发消息，请在输入框键入内容！');

        }

        // 精确构建纯净的 <msg> 消息行，全面支持文本、转账、红包、照片、语音、公众号、名片、位置、表情包全部九种类型

            }
        }).join('\n');

    function getAudioCandidateUrls(track) {
        if (!track) return [];
        const candidates = [];
        let rawSrc = (track.src || '').trim();
        let songId = track.songId || '';
        if (!songId && rawSrc) {
            const m = rawSrc.match(/id=(\d+)/i);
            if (m) songId = m[1];
        }

        if (rawSrc.startsWith('blob:') || rawSrc.startsWith('data:')) {
            candidates.push(rawSrc);
            return candidates;
        }

        if (songId) {
            candidates.push(`https://api.injahow.cn/meting/?type=url&id=${songId}`);
            candidates.push(`https://music.163.com/song/media/outer/url?id=${songId}.mp3`);
            candidates.push(`https://v.api.aa1.cn/api/wymusic/index.php?id=${songId}`);
        }
        if (rawSrc) {
            candidates.push(rawSrc.replace(/^http:\/\//i, 'https://'));
        }
        return candidates;
    }

    function ensureAudioInstance() {
        if (!audioObj) {
            let existingDomAudio = shadow.getElementById('st-phone-hidden-audio-node');

                existingDomAudio.setAttribute('referrerpolicy', 'no-referrer');

                shadow.appendChild(existingDomAudio);
            }
            audioObj = existingDomAudio;

            audioObj.onended = () => {
                playTrack(state.musicIndex + 1);
            };
            audioObj.onerror = () => {
                const curTrack = state.musicPlaylist[state.musicIndex];
                const candidates = getAudioCandidateUrls(curTrack);
                audioObj._candidateIndex = (audioObj._candidateIndex || 0) + 1;
                if (candidates && audioObj._candidateIndex < candidates.length) {
                    audioObj.src = candidates[audioObj._candidateIndex];
                    audioObj.load();
                    const p = audioObj.play();
                    if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') {
                        p.catch(() => {});
                    }
                } else {
                    state.music.playing = false;
                    updateMusicUI();
                    if (typeof triggerSlash === 'function') {
                        triggerSlash('/echo severity=warning 当前曲目音频源响应超时，已尝试切换备用线路。');
                    }
                }
            };
            audioObj.onplay = () => {
                state.music.playing = true;
                updateMusicUI();
            };
            audioObj.onpause = () => {
                state.music.playing = false;
                updateMusicUI();
            };
        }
        return audioObj;
    }

    function playTrack(idx) {
        if (!state.musicPlaylist || state.musicPlaylist.length === 0) return;
        if (idx < 0) idx = state.musicPlaylist.length - 1;
        if (idx >= state.musicPlaylist.length) idx = 0;
        state.musicIndex = idx;
        const curTrack = state.musicPlaylist[state.musicIndex];
        state.music.title = curTrack.title;
        state.music.author = curTrack.author;
        state.music.src = curTrack.src;

        const player = ensureAudioInstance();
        const candidates = getAudioCandidateUrls(curTrack);
        player._candidateIndex = 0;

        try {
            player.pause();
            player.src = candidates[0] || curTrack.src;
            player.load();
            const p = player.play();
            if (p && typeof p.then === 'function') {
                p.then(() => {
                    state.music.playing = true;
                    updateMusicUI();
                }).catch((err) => {
                    if (candidates.length > 1) {
                        player._candidateIndex = 1;
                        player.src = candidates[1];
                        player.load();
                        player.play().then(() => {
                            state.music.playing = true;
                            updateMusicUI();
                        }).catch(() => {
                            state.music.playing = false;
                            updateMusicUI();
                        });
                    } else {
                        state.music.playing = false;
                        updateMusicUI();
                    }
                });
            } else {
                state.music.playing = true;
                updateMusicUI();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            state.music.playing = false;
            updateMusicUI();
        }

        saveState();
        updateMusicUI();
    }

    function toggleAudio() {
        const player = ensureAudioInstance();

        if (state.music.playing) {
            player.pause();
            state.music.playing = false;
            saveState();
            updateMusicUI();
            return;
        }

        if (player.src && player.currentTime > 0 && !player.ended) {
            const resumePromise = player.play();
            if (resumePromise && typeof resumePromise.then === 'function') {
                resumePromise.then(() => {
                    state.music.playing = true;
                    saveState();
                    updateMusicUI();
                }).catch(() => {
                    playTrack(state.musicIndex);
                });
            } else {
                state.music.playing = true;
                saveState();
                updateMusicUI();
            }
            return;
        }

        playTrack(state.musicIndex);
    }

    function togglePhone() {

            phoneWrapper.classList.add('active');
            const curW = targetWindow.innerWidth || 1200;
            const curH = targetWindow.innerHeight || 800;

            const bCenterX = bRect.left + bRect.width / 2;
            const bCenterY = bRect.top + bRect.height / 2;

            const scale = parseFloat(state.config.scale) || 0.7;
            const phoneW = 430;
            const phoneH = 860;
            const renderW = phoneW * scale;
            const renderH = phoneH * scale;

            let idealCenterLeft = bCenterX - phoneW / 2;
            let idealCenterTop = bCenterY - phoneH / 2;

            const minMargin = 10;
            const renderLeft = idealCenterLeft + (phoneW - renderW) / 2;
            const renderTop = idealCenterTop + (phoneH - renderH) / 2;

            if (renderLeft < minMargin) {
                idealCenterLeft += (minMargin - renderLeft);
            } else if (renderLeft + renderW > curW - minMargin) {
                idealCenterLeft -= ((renderLeft + renderW) - (curW - minMargin));
            }

            if (renderTop < minMargin) {
                idealCenterTop += (minMargin - renderTop);
            } else if (renderTop + renderH > curH - minMargin) {
                idealCenterTop -= ((renderTop + renderH) - (curH - minMargin));
            }

            phoneWrapper.style.left = Math.round(idealCenterLeft) + 'px';

        });

        phoneBodyBox.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
            if (e.touches.length !== 1) return;
            if (e.target.closest('.screen-content, .dynamic-island, #btn-phone-quick-close')) return;
            startPhoneDrag(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
        }, { passive: true });
    }

    // 全局已处理消息唯一指纹缓存库，杜绝三个监听器同时并发造成的重复解析与连发三次问题
    const processedMsgFingerprints = new Set();

    // 核心消息处理引擎：单楼层精确处理，杜绝扫描多楼层导致的重复提取与连发
    function processIncomingMessage(targetMsgId) {
        if (typeof getChatMessages !== 'function') return;
        let msgs = null;
        try {
            if (targetMsgId === undefined || targetMsgId === null || targetMsgId === -1) {
                msgs = getChatMessages(-1);
            } else {
                msgs = getChatMessages(targetMsgId);
            }
            if (!msgs || !msgs.length) {
                msgs = getChatMessages(-1);
            }
        } catch (err) {
            try { msgs = getChatMessages(-1); } catch (e) {}
        }
        if (!msgs || !msgs.length) return;

        let hasNewChat = false;
        let hasNewMoment = false;

        const templateBlacklist = ['发送人角色名', '发布人姓名', '评论人姓名', '角色真名', '评论人真名', '目标角色名', '文案正文', '动态正文', '具体聊天内容', '照片画面具体描述'];
        const isValidRoleName = (name) => {
            if (!name || name.length > 18) return false;
            if (templateBlacklist.some(bad => name.includes(bad))) return false;
            if (/[\n\r<>{}$/`\\]/.test(name)) return false;
            return true;
        };

        // 遍历这几层楼进行纯净提取
        msgs.forEach(floorMsg => {
            let rawText = floorMsg.message || '';
            if (/<(?:st-wb|st-script|st-regex|st-test|edit\s+id=)/i.test(rawText)) return;
            rawText = sanitizeCoT(rawText);

            const cleanTextUnified = rawText.replace(/<\/?msg>/gi, '').replace(/<\/?moments>/gi, '').replace(/【/g, '[').replace(/】/g, ']').replace(/丨/g, '|');
            
            // 严格区分：识别格式为 [微信|发送人|...] 或 [微信|user|发给:目标|...]
            const wxRegex = /\[微信\s*\|\s*([^|\]]+)\s*\|\s*(?:发给:([^|\]]+)\s*\|\s*)?(?:(文本|语音|转账|红包|照片|表情包|公众号)\s*\|\s*)?([^\]]+)\]/g;
            let match;

            while ((match = wxRegex.exec(cleanTextUnified)) !== null) {
                const rawSender = match[1].trim();
                const explicitTarget = match[2] ? match[2].trim() : '';
                const kind = match[3] ? match[3].trim() : '文本';
                const content = match[4].trim();

                if (!content || content.includes('${') || templateBlacklist.includes(content)) continue;

                // 彻底隔离判定：只要是 user、me、或匹配本地设定的用户名，绝对视为 user 发言
                const isMe = (rawSender.toLowerCase() === 'user' || rawSender.toLowerCase() === 'me' || rawSender === state.config.myName);

                let targetThreadId = null;

                if (isMe) {
                    if (explicitTarget) {
                        const foundTarget = state.contacts.find(c => c.name === explicitTarget || explicitTarget.includes(c.name) || c.name.includes(explicitTarget));
                        targetThreadId = foundTarget ? foundTarget.id : currentChatTarget;
                    } else {
                        targetThreadId = currentChatTarget;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (!isValidRoleName(rawSender)) continue;

                    let targetContact = state.contacts.find(c =>
                        c.name === rawSender ||
                        rawSender.includes(c.name) ||
                        c.name.includes(rawSender)
                    );

                    // 仅当确认不是 user 时，才作为新联系人登记，杜绝产生诡异陌生人
                    if (!targetContact) {
                        const newId = 'c_' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5);
                        targetContact = {
                            id: newId,
                            name: rawSender,
                            handle: 'wx_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 899999 + 100000),
                            signature: '',
                            avatar: '',
                            frame: 0,
                            relationDesc: '',
                            blocked: false
                        };
                        state.contacts.push(targetContact);
                        state.threads[newId] = [];
                    }

                    targetThreadId = targetContact.id;
                }

                if (!targetThreadId) targetThreadId = 'c_pei';
                if (!state.threads[targetThreadId]) state.threads[targetThreadId] = [];

                let messageKind = 'text';
                let parsedAmount = 0;
                let parsedNote = '';

                if (kind === '转账') {
                    messageKind = 'transfer';
                    const parts = content.split('|');
                    parsedAmount = parseFloat(parts[0]) || 0;
                    parsedNote = parts[1] || '转账';
                    // 若收到转账，自动加入支付宝/微信零钱
                    if (!isMe && parsedAmount > 0) {
                        const existsTransfer = state.threads[targetThreadId].some(m => m.kind === 'transfer' && m.amount === parsedAmount && m.note === parsedNote);
                        if (!existsTransfer) {
                            state.wallet.balance += parsedAmount;
                            state.wallet.bills.unshift({ id: 'b_' + Date.now(), title: `收到 ${senderName} 转账`, amount: parsedAmount, time: '刚刚', type: 'in' });
                        }
                    }
                } else if (kind === '红包') {
                    messageKind = 'redpacket';
                    const parts = content.split('|');
                    parsedAmount = parseFloat(parts[0]) || 0;
                    parsedNote = parts[1] || '微信红包';
                } else if (kind === '语音') {
                    messageKind = 'voice';
                } else if (kind === '照片') {
                    messageKind = 'image';
                } else if (kind === '表情包') {
                    messageKind = 'sticker';
                } else if (kind === '公众号') {
                    messageKind = 'article';
                }

                const msgFingerprint = `${targetThreadId}_${isMe ? 'me' : 'other'}_${messageKind}_${content}_${parsedAmount}`;
                if (processedMsgFingerprints.has(msgFingerprint)) {
                    continue;
                }

                const exists = state.threads[targetThreadId].some(m => {
                    if (isMe ? m.sender !== 'me' : m.sender !== targetThreadId) return false;
                    if (m.kind !== messageKind) return false;
                    if (messageKind === 'transfer') return m.amount === parsedAmount;
                    return m.text === content;
                });
                if (!exists) {
                    processedMsgFingerprints.add(msgFingerprint);
                    if (processedMsgFingerprints.size > 800) {
                        const firstItem = processedMsgFingerprints.values().next().value;
                        processedMsgFingerprints.delete(firstItem);
                    }
                    const newChatObj = {
                        id: 'm_' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5),
                        sender: isMe ? 'me' : targetThreadId,
                        kind: messageKind,
                        text: content,
                        time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
                    };
                    if (messageKind === 'image') {
                        if (content.startsWith('http://') || content.startsWith('https://')) {
                            newChatObj.src = content;
                        } else {
                            newChatObj.desc = content;
                        }
                    } else if (messageKind === 'sticker') {
                        const trimmedContent = content.trim();
                        newChatObj.text = trimmedContent;
                        const cleanStkKey = trimmedContent.replace(/^(稳稳打上绿色的合格对勾|绿色对勾通过)$/, '绿色对勾通过');
                        // 严格精确匹配，彻底废弃模糊包含匹配，防止普通文本误命中绿色对勾
                        const matchedCute = ASSETS.cuteStickers.find(s => s.name === trimmedContent || s.name === cleanStkKey);
                        if (matchedCute) {
                            newChatObj.src = matchedCute.url;
                            newChatObj.text = matchedCute.name;
                        } else if (trimmedContent.startsWith('http://') || trimmedContent.startsWith('https://') || trimmedContent.startsWith('data:')) {
                            newChatObj.src = trimmedContent;
                        } else {
                            newChatObj.src = '';
                        }
                    } else if (messageKind === 'transfer') {
                        newChatObj.amount = parsedAmount;
                        newChatObj.note = parsedNote;
                    } else if (messageKind === 'redpacket') {
                        newChatObj.amount = parsedAmount;
                        newChatObj.desc = parsedNote;
                    }
                    state.threads[targetThreadId].push(newChatObj);
                    hasNewChat = true;
                }
            }

            // 在同一楼层循环内按文本顺序联合解析【朋友圈动态】与【朋友圈评论】，确保多条动态与评论穿插时精准对应
            const momCombinedRegex = /\[(朋友圈|朋友圈评论)\s*\|\s*([^\]]+)\]/g;
            let momCombinedMatch;
            let activeMomentItem = state.moments[0] || null;

            while ((momCombinedMatch = momCombinedRegex.exec(cleanTextUnified)) !== null) {
                const tagType = momCombinedMatch[1].trim();
                const bodyStr = momCombinedMatch[2];
                const parts = bodyStr.split('|').map(s => s.trim());

                if (tagType === '朋友圈' && parts.length >= 2) {
                    const posterName = parts[0] || '';
                    const momText = parts[1] || '';
                    const momDesc = parts[2] || '';
                    const momTime = parts[3] || '刚刚';

                    if (!isValidRoleName(posterName)) continue;
                    if (posterName.includes('未知号码') || posterName.includes('138****')) continue;
                    if (!momText || momText.includes('${') || templateBlacklist.includes(momText)) continue;

                    const isMe = (posterName === 'me' || posterName.toLowerCase() === 'user' || posterName === state.config.myName);
                    let authorId = 'me';
                    let ownerName = posterName;

                    if (!isMe) {
                        let targetContact = state.contacts.find(c => c.name === posterName || posterName.includes(c.name) || c.name.includes(posterName));
                        authorId = targetContact ? targetContact.id : ('npc_' + posterName);
                    }

                    let existingMom = state.moments.find(m => m.text === momText && (m.owner === authorId || m.ownerName === ownerName));
                    if (!existingMom) {
                        existingMom = {
                            id: 'mom_' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5),
                            owner: authorId,
                            ownerName: ownerName,
                            text: momText,
                            descImg: momDesc,
                            date: momTime,
                            likes: [],
                            comments: []
                        };
                        state.moments.unshift(existingMom);
                        hasNewMoment = true;
                    }
                    activeMomentItem = existingMom;
                } else if (tagType === '朋友圈评论' && parts.length >= 2) {
                    const targetMom = activeMomentItem || state.moments[0];
                    if (!targetMom) continue;

                    const cmtAuthor = parts[0] || '';
                    const replyTo = parts.length >= 3 ? parts[1] : '';
                    const cmtContent = parts.length >= 3 ? parts.slice(2).join('|') : parts[1];

                    if (!isValidRoleName(cmtAuthor)) continue;
                    if (cmtAuthor.includes('未知号码') || cmtAuthor.includes('138****')) continue;
                    if (!cmtContent || cmtContent.includes('${') || templateBlacklist.includes(cmtContent)) continue;

                    const formattedCmtText = (replyTo ? `回复 ${replyTo}：` : '') + cmtContent;

                    if (!targetMom.comments) targetMom.comments = [];
                    const existsCmt = targetMom.comments.some(c => c.name === cmtAuthor && c.text === formattedCmtText);
                    if (!existsCmt) {
                        targetMom.comments.push({
                            name: cmtAuthor,
                            text: formattedCmtText
                        });
                        hasNewMoment = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        if (hasNewChat) {
            saveState();
            renderThreads();
            renderChatMessages();
            const titleEl = shadow.getElementById('chat-target-name');
            const targetObj = [...state.contacts, ...state.groups].find(x => x.id === currentChatTarget);
            if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = targetObj ? targetObj.name : '微信';

            const stream = shadow.getElementById('chat-msg-stream');
            if (stream) stream.scrollTop = stream.scrollHeight;
        }

        if (hasNewMoment) {
            saveState();
            renderMoments();
        }
    }

    if (typeof eventOn === 'function') {
        const msgRecEvent = (typeof tavern_events !== 'undefined' && tavern_events.MESSAGE_RECEIVED) ? tavern_events.MESSAGE_RECEIVED : 'MESSAGE_RECEIVED';
        const msgUpdEvent = (typeof tavern_events !== 'undefined' && tavern_events.MESSAGE_UPDATED) ? tavern_events.MESSAGE_UPDATED : 'MESSAGE_UPDATED';

        eventOn(msgRecEvent, (message_id) => {
            processIncomingMessage(message_id);
            setTimeout(() => processIncomingMessage(-1), 300);
        });

        eventOn(msgUpdEvent, (message_id) => {
            processIncomingMessage(message_id);
        });
    }

    // 定时轻量级扫描最新楼层，确保任何流式输出或异步回复都能实时同步进小手机
    let lastScannedRawLength = 0;
    const syncTimer = setInterval(() => {
        if (typeof getChatMessages !== 'function') return;
        try {
            const latest = getChatMessages(-1);
            if (latest && latest.length > 0 && latest[0].message) {
                const len = latest[0].message.length;
                if (len !== lastScannedRawLength) {
                    lastScannedRawLength = len;
                    processIncomingMessage(-1);
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    }, 1500);

    if (typeof appendInexistentScriptButtons === 'function') {
        appendInexistentScriptButtons([{ name: '诗集小手机', visible: true }]);
    }
    if (typeof eventOn === 'function' && typeof getButtonEvent === 'function') {
        eventOn(getButtonEvent('诗集小手机'), () => {
            togglePhone();
        });
    }

    $(window).on('pagehide', () => {
        if (syncTimer) clearInterval(syncTimer);
        const orphan = targetDoc.getElementById(WIDGET_ID);
        if (orphan) orphan.remove();
        const bridgeFrame = targetDoc.getElementById('st-poem-audio-bridge-iframe');
        if (bridgeFrame) bridgeFrame.remove();
        if (audioObj) {
            try { audioObj.pause(); audioObj.src = ''; } catch(e){}
            audioObj = null;
        }
    });

})();
